comparison_metrics.composition: contact, impact, effector/block motion, phase, target task, final success
comparison_metrics.composition_role: post-hoc only; excluded from training, inference, policy selection, primary thresholds
comparison_metrics.gate: every causal feature block, frozen-normalized z summaries, scores, rankings, price exceedance, call histograms
comparison_metrics.latent_inputs: history/target norms, moments, temporal changes, normalized actions
comparison_metrics.model: d0 and d1-d4 raw/discovery-whitened losses; update norms; gains; positive-gain rates
comparison_metrics.raw_inputs: pixel RGB moments/temporal change; observation moments; raw actions

all_required: PlanOracle 90-episode core mean lies inside frozen joint offline max-T region
PlanOracle is materially closer than paired MarkovOracle: standardized Euclidean distance ratio <= 0.70 and closer on >=5/7 core coordinates
PlanOracle d1-to-d2 mean marginal gain is >0 (the two offline split-specific means and their frozen pooled band are reported descriptively)
frozen gate prospective discovery criteria all pass
all validity, isolation, hash, exact-call, FLOP, and dense/sparse audits pass

decision_rules.distribution_matched_gate_failed: PlanOracle matches the core/base distribution but frozen gate criteria fail; no V5; recommend smallest domain-robust gate discovery study

all_required: 95% episode-bootstrap CI lower bound >0 versus analytic strongest transition-independent exact-total-FLOP mixture
95% episode-bootstrap CI lower bound >0 versus conservative seeded integer exact-total-FLOP mixture
95% episode-bootstrap CI lower bound >0 versus fixed d1
95% episode-bootstrap CI lower bound >0 versus exact call-histogram randomization
discovery-whitened point benefit >0 versus analytic exact-total-FLOP mixture
score/gain Spearman is >0 at all three decisions
adaptive point is nondominated in both call and fully-counted-FLOP frontiers

decision_rules.generator_reconstruction_failed: PlanOracle misses the core offline region or is not materially closer than paired MarkovOracle; permit only the smallest bounded version/action-semantics/replay check, never gate tuning

frozen_adaptive_contract.stopping_rule: start at d1; continue at each of d1,d2,d3 iff frozen score > frozen compute price

preprocessing.target_alignment: model steps 3..40; target latent at exactly the next model step

reference_region.episode_estimand: equal-weight episode mean; every episode has 38 prediction rows
reference_region.joint_region: 95% max-|studentized mean deviation| region over frozen core metrics

related_work_note: LoopWM is relevant adaptive-computation work in text environments.

rng_contract.oracle: numpy.random.seed(oracle_np_seed) after environment reset and before first action; required because OGBench 1.2.1 PlanOracle and MarkovOracle use NumPy global RNG
rng_contract.pairing: PlanOracle and MarkovOracle use identical environment seeds and separate wrapper/oracle streams

runtime_benchmark.measurement: synchronized end-to-end base prediction plus solver/gate path
